key_insight: Syn4D is a multiview synthetic 4D dataset that delivers dense, accurate geometric and tracking annotations (camera motion, depth, dense tracking, parametric human pose), enabling robust evaluation and training for dynamic scene reconstruction and tracking from video.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of high-quality datasets with dense, complete, and accurate geometric annotations for dynamic scenes, which has limited progress in monocular video 3D reconstruction and object/person tracking.
method: Generate multiview synthetic dynamic scenes with controllable variations (motion, lighting, interactions).
Provide ground-truth annotations per frame: camera motion, dense depth maps, per-vertex/point tracking, and parametric human poses.
Package the dataset for benchmarking: synchronized multiview sequences plus standardized splits and metrics for reconstruction and tracking tasks.
impact: Syn4D enables reproducible benchmarking and data-driven development of algorithms for dynamic 3D reconstruction and tracking, reducing reliance on scarce real-world annotations and accelerating progress in vision research and applications.
visual_elements: Dataset overview diagram showing multiview camera rigs capturing a dynamic scene (label cameras, timelines).
Example frame triplet: RGB image, corresponding depth map, and dense tracking/flow overlay for the same timestamp.
Annotation legend: icons and short captions for provided annotations (camera motion, depth, dense tracking, parametric pose).
Bar chart or table mockup showing how Syn4D fills annotation gaps compared to existing datasets (coverage vs. annotation types).
paper_authors: Zeren Jiang, Yushi Lan, Yihang Luo, Yufan Deng, Zihang Lai
